label: prose:intro-magic-shells
html: Unwrapping the integer-linear-programming solution counts across the (Z, N) plane isolates the nuclear magic numbers (2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126), the shell closures explained by the spin–orbit shell model of Goeppert Mayer [mayer1949] and of Haxel, Jensen and Suess, as points of Schur–Weyl self-duality where the active Wedderburn partition coincides with its conjugate (\lambda = \lambda'). This section proves the self-duality criterion, distinguishes the compound-\beta shell calibration from the single-wrap nuclear base, and defines the dimensionless magic-shell coupling \kappa.
